label: assertion
text: the layerwise message-passing semantics are preserved in quaternion space.
完整表述: The MESSAGE, AGGREGATE, and UPDATE functions of any message-passing GNN are replaced by their quaternion counterparts so that the layerwise message-passing semantics are preserved in quaternion space.

label: assertion
text: Representing layer weights as quaternion matrices and grouping four real feature channels into one quaternion reduces the number of independent trainable real parameters by a factor of four relative to an equivalent real-valued GNN weight matrix:
完整表述: Representing layer weights as quaternion matrices and grouping four real feature channels into one quaternion reduces the number of independent trainable real parameters by a factor of four relative to an equivalent real-valued GNN weight matrix.

label: 论据
text: a quaternion weight mapping from $F$ real input features to $F'$ real outputs uses $F/4\times F'/4$ quaternion entries , yielding one-fourth the degrees of freedom of the corresponding real weight matrix.
完整表述: A quaternion weight mapping from $F$ real input features to $F'$ real outputs uses $F/4\times F'/4$ quaternion entries, yielding one-fourth the degrees of freedom of the corresponding real weight matrix.

label: assertion

label: assertion
text: When QMPNN variants of standard GNN architectures are trained under the same hyperparameters and evaluated on standard datasets, the quaternion models achieve comparable or better accuracy, ROC-AUC, or Hits@K while using roughly one-fourth of the trainable parameters.
完整表述: When QMPNN variants of standard GNN architectures are trained under the same hyperparameters as those standard GNN architectures and evaluated on standard datasets, the quaternion models achieve comparable or better accuracy, ROC-AUC, or Hits@K (proportion of top-K predictions that are correct) while using roughly one-fourth of the trainable parameters of those standard GNN architectures.
